name: Spinnable
basis: Spinnable's own public pages and, for company basics only, the news sources named beside each fact
what: Spinnable sells AI workers that a business hires for a role; each has its own email address, can be reached on WhatsApp, Slack and voice, and acts in the customer's connected tools.

facts.fact: Launched at Web Summit 2025 with a release datelined Lisbon, 9 November 2025
Co-founded by Vasco Pedro, Gil Coelho and Fabio Kepler, all formerly of Unbabel
facts.span: Vasco co-founded Spinnable alongside Gil Coelho, former Head of Product at Unbabel,

facts.fact: Raised about 2 million euros in a pre-seed round led by HeartCore, Florent.vc and Alphagraph (Essential Business, 12 November 2025)
facts.span: raise around €2 million in a pre-seed round

facts.fact: Plans: Starter at 50 USD a month with 2 AI workers; Business from 150 USD with 5; Enterprise custom
facts.span: Starter is $50 per month with 2 AI workers

facts.fact: Application and primary database hosted in the EU
facts.span: Our application and primary database are hosted in the EU.

facts.fact: SOC 2 Type II is stated as in progress
facts.span: SOC 2 Type II certification in progress.

facts.fact: Publishes a vulnerability disclosure policy (v1.0, effective 13 May 2026) that permits prompt injection testing against a researcher's own workers
facts.span: Permitted exclusively against your own AI workers.

solutions.name: Spinnable AI employees (called AI workers in the documentation)
solutions.what: Role-based AI workers with their own email address, memory, scheduled tasks and access to 35+ connected tools, reachable by email, WhatsApp, Slack, meetings and voice.

solutions.name: Spinnable ID
solutions.what: Gives a person's Claude or ChatGPT assistant its own WhatsApp number, email and identity, running on the person's own model plan.

solutions.name: Website Chat Widget
solutions.what: An embeddable widget through which website visitors talk to a Spinnable worker.

solutions.name: Spinnable Enterprise
solutions.what: Plan adding SSO, audit logs, EU data residency, workspace roles and onboarding support.

stories.what: CEO testimonial: two workers, one running calendar, outreach and pipeline, one watching a market.
stories.span: Clara manages my calendar, runs my outreach, and keeps my pipeline current.

stories.what: Documentation example: a healthcare technology provider refining its customer support worker through feedback.
stories.span: uses Spinnable's feedback system to continuously refine their customer support worker.

stories.what: Co-founder testimonial: several workers across a family office handling email, travel, outreach and bookings.
stories.span: I run multiple AI workers across my family office and ventures

stories.what: Partner testimonial: workers that act on the company's processes.
stories.span: Spinnable gave us truly autonomous agents that understand our processes and act independently.

stories.what: Chief of Staff testimonial on hiring workers and chatting with them on WhatsApp.
stories.span: Workers are ridiculously easy to hire

stories.what: At launch the company said 10 of its 15 staff were not human (Essential Business).
stories.span: has 15 staff but 10 are not human
